The season started on 18 August 2025 and was originally scheduled to end on 15 May 2026,{{Cite web|url=https://www.persianfootball.com/news/2025/06/30/dates-for-2025-26-pgpl-season-confirmed/|title=Dates for 2025/26 PGPL season confirmed – PersianFootball.com}} but the league has been suspended due to the [[2026 Iran war]]. The league is expected to resume after the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]],{{Cite web |date=2026-04-19 |title=Iran’s PGPL resumption date confirmed |url=https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/525569/Iran-s-PGPL-resumption-date-confirmed |access-date=2026-06-04 |website=Tehran Times |language=en}} but was eventually abandoned. ==Teams== ===Promotion and relegation (pre-season)=== A total of sixteen teams contest the league, including fourteen sides from the [[2024–25 Persian Gulf Pro League|2024–25 season]] and two promoted from the [[2024–25 Azadegan League]]. This includes the two top teams from the Azadegan League. [[Fajr Sepasi Shiraz F.C.|Fajr Sepasi]] and [[Paykan F.C.|Paykan]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.persianfootball.com/news/2025/05/22/paykan-win-promotion-to-the-pgpl/|title=Paykan win promotion to the PGPL – PersianFootball.com}} They replaced [[F.C.
